speaker: druid
text: Huh? I don't know... My head hurts...

speaker: diaena
text: Be careful... Don't try to stand up so fast.

speaker: druid
text: Where am I? Who are you?...

speaker: diaena
text: Are you okay to move? I think we should get out of here.

speaker: diaena
text: The Tornville dires. They probably already smelled your presence.

speaker: diaena
text: But this raven seems to like your smell... She's been waiting patiently for you to wake up.

speaker: druid
text: Fly my love. Soar high and let me know if there's anyone coming.

speaker: druid
text: Quick! Hide! I'll try to look for something around to help defend this glade.
